title: US monthly equity expiration (January 2027) — the last NYSE session before the January FOMC blackout opens
source: EST: three independent primary surfaces, all re-fetched direct by this event's own initial research on 2026-09-06 rather than inherited from the proposal. (1) DIRECT LISTING: www-api.cboe.com/us/futures/market_statistics/settlement/csv?dt=2026-09-04 (HTTP 200 after one 301, 1,731 bytes) carries the live S&P 500 Variance futures row `VA,VA/F7,2027-01-15,298.25` — a real daily settlement price against an expiration dated 2027-01-15 itself, the same class of evidence by which opex-2027-06-17 was filed off `VA,VA/M7,2027-06-17,319.25`. (2) CONTRACT SPEC, INDEPENDENTLY: the same file returns `VX,VX/Z6,2026-12-16,18.975`, and Cboe's VX terms settle to the SOQ of the SPX/SPXW series expiring exactly 30 calendar days later — 2026-12-16 + 30d = 2027-01-15. Re-running that rule across all 14 listed VX rows reproduces every third-Friday expiration this calendar already tracks and invents none. (3) ARITHMETIC AGAINST A FETCHED HOLIDAY TABLE: January 2027's Fridays are the 1st, 8th, 15th, 22nd and 29th, so the third Friday is the 15th; nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars (HTTP 200, 109,180 bytes, holiday table parsed cell-by-cell this session) puts January 2027's only closures on Friday 2027-01-01 (New Year's Day) and Monday 2027-01-18 (Martin Luther King, Jr. Day) — neither displaces the 15th, so the date is unadjusted, unlike 2027-06-18 which Juneteenth pulls to the Thursday. Filed estimate rather than confirmed because this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, because the variance row dates the index leg while a monthly expiration also covers single-stock options, and because no expiration CALENDAR was read directly: theocc.com returned HTTP 403 on both its schedules page and its 2027 expiration-calendar media URL, and cdn.cboe.com's 2027_Expiration_Calendar.pdf returned HTTP 403, to this runner on 2026-09-06. PROMOTION CRITERION: fetch an OCC or Cboe expiration calendar that lists 2027-01-15 directly. `OCC:` is the prefix this class promotes under. Checked 2026-09-06
notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN at this event's own initial research (2026-09-06, docs/research/events/opex-2027-01-15.md), from the single prior proposal `opex-2027-01-15.from-opex-2027-05-21.json` — which stands as filed and is now shadowed. Impact MEDIUM per the class rule this calendar runs at 8 of 9 (quarterly triple witchings `high`, ordinary monthlies `medium`); the 2027 quarterlies are 03-19, 06-17, 09-17 and 12-17, so this is an ordinary monthly. WHAT DISTINGUISHES IT, verified this session against a direct federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm fetch (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes; 2027 panel Jan 26-27, Mar 16-17*, Apr 27-28, Jun 8-9*, Jul 27-28, Sep 14-15*, Oct 26-27, Dec 7-8*, last updated 2026-08-19): the January meeting is Tue-Wed 2027-01-26/27, so the communications blackout opens 00:00 ET Saturday 2027-01-16 (fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16, already tracked) and lifts Thursday 2027-01-28. 2027-01-15 is therefore the LAST NYSE session before that blackout — one of exactly four 2027 third Fridays in that class (01-15, 04-16, 07-16, 10-15, the late-month-meeting months) — and its entire five-session post-expiration window, 2027-01-19 through 2027-01-25, is Fed-silent, ending two sessions before the decision. THE MEASUREMENT FINDING THAT MATTERS MOST HERE, and the reason this entry is worth more than a hole-fill: this expiration's post-expiration window is the most measurement-contaminated on the 2027 board. MLK falls Monday 2027-01-18, three days after the expiration, so the first post-expiration return spans FOUR calendar days and the five-session window spans TEN (against a clean seven), while the pre-expiration window 2027-01-08 -> 2027-01-15 spans a clean seven. Measured on QQQ over 120 third Fridays 2016-2026 (Yahoo chart API, fetched direct this session), the un-normalised five-session close-to-close realized-volatility ratio that all four forward tests registered on this shelf use is inflated by a median +16.6% wherever the post window carries a closure, and +29.0% in this exact sub-class. The consequence is stated plainly because a later session would otherwise inherit a false prior: the January cell reads 8/10 raw and its 4-day-gap sub-class reads 5/5 (100%), but restricted to one-calendar-day returns those become 5/10 and 2/5. See the ledger's legs 3-5. ADJACENCY: only fomc-blackout-start-2027-01-16 (+1d) was tracked inside the +/-5-day corridor before this session; vix-expiration-2027-01-20 (+5d) was a hole and is proposed in the same PR off the direct `VX,VX/F7,2027-01-20,19.9997` listing. Estimate widens caution only; no house playbook is opex-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped 2026-09-06 for `opex|expiration|witching|SOQ|third friday|LEAPS|pin`, zero hits in both), and nothing here licenses an entry.
